been published for it yet. The changes since 2.2.0:
  - **2.2.1 / 2.2.2:** pi no longer posts its reply twice (cv/pi-action#43). pi-action no longer installs its git hooks in this repository (cv/pi-action#41). A response cut off by `max_tokens` no longer ends the run (cv/pi-action#36). The workflow log shows how to read the thread with git (cv/pi-action#37).
  - **[2.3.0](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases/tag/v2.3.0):** a thread keeps the files pi leaves uncommitted on `refs/pi/worktrees/<number>` and restores them on the next run. This is on by default through the new `worktree_snapshots` input (cv/pi-action#44). The workflow log now shows each step pi takes (cv/pi-action#48, #49, #50). A fetch into `refs/pi/*` no longer breaks the run, and a failed session is reported (cv/pi-action#47).
  - **2.4.0:** new `exclude_tools` and `model_tools_hidden` inputs, prompt templates (`/<name>`) from extensions, and a log line when an extension replaces a tool (cv/pi-action#56).
- **pit v0.35.0 → v0.35.1** in `extensions`, the latest release.

All new inputs keep their defaults. In particular, this PR doesn't set `model_tools_hidden`. cv/pi-action#58 sets it to `read, write, edit, bash` in pi-action's own workflow; that can come in a separate PR.
